title: ChemVTS-Bench: Evaluating Visual-Textual-Symbolic Reasoning of Multimodal Large Language Models in Chemistry
abstract: arXiv:2511.17909v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chemical reasoning inherently integrates visual, textual, and symbolic modalities, yet existing benchmarks rarely capture this complexity, often relying on simple image-text pairs with limited chemical semantics. As a result, the actual ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to process and integrate chemically meaningful information across modalities remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{ChemVTS-Bench}, a domain-authentic benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the Visual-Textual-Symbolic (VTS) reasoning abilities of MLLMs. ChemVTS-Bench contains diverse and challenging chemical problems spanning organic molecules, inorganic materials, and 3D crystal structures, with each task presented in three complementary input modes: (1) visual-only, (2) visual-text hybrid, and (3) SMILES-based symbolic input. This design enables fine-grained analysis of modality-dependent reasoning behaviors and cross-modal integration. To en

translated_title: ChemVTS-Bench：评估多模态大语言模型在化学中的视觉-文本-符号推理能力
translated_abstract: 化学推理本质上融合了视觉、文本和符号三种模态，然而现有的基准测试很少能捕捉这种复杂性，往往依赖于化学语义有限的简单图像-文本对。因此，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）处理和整合跨模态化学有意义信息的实际能力仍不明确。我们提出了ChemVTS-Bench，这是一个领域真实（domain-authentic）的基准，旨在系统评估多模态大语言模型的视觉-文本-符号（VTS）推理能力。ChemVTS-Bench包含多样且具有挑战性的化学问题，涵盖有机分子、无机材料和三维晶体结构，每个任务以三种互补的输入模式呈现：（1）纯视觉模式，（2）视觉-文本混合模式，以及（3）基于SMILES的符号输入。这种设计使得能够对依赖模态的推理行为和跨模态整合能力进行细粒度分析。为了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了ChemVTS-Bench——一个领域真实的基准，通过涵盖有机分子、无机材料和三维晶体结构的问题以及三种互补输入模式（纯视觉、视觉-文本混合、SMILES符号输入），系统评估多模态大语言模型在化学中的视觉-文本-符号（VTS）推理能力。
en_tdlr: ChemVTS-Bench is a domain-authentic benchmark that systematically evaluates the Visual-Textual-Symbolic (VTS) reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models in chemistry, spanning organic molecules, inorganic materials, and 3D crystal structures across three complementary input modes for fine-grained analysis of modality-dependent reasoning and cross-modal integration.
